parts.original_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: churn logit = -2.60 + linear term (direct edges) + dayEveUsageHinges + serviceCallsHinges + internationalPlanHinge + rareStateSwitches + nearLinearUnits + vmailRelayDeadCascade, an additive (parallel) composition at the output pre-activation; output = sigmoid. Linear term: internationalPlan +0.79/SD (+2.70 logit for holders), voiceMailPlan -0.69/SD (-1.57), numberVmailMessages +0.65/SD (partly cancelling the plan), totalIntlMinutes +0.39, totalIntlCalls -0.28, totalDayCalls +0.12, accountLength +0.10, and 27 per-state offsets (largest: state:46 -2.00 on 80 rows, state:47 +1.39 on 72, state:4 +1.21 on 41, state:5 -0.96 on 78, state:49 -0.66 on 122). 21 inputs are unconnected (zero effect). EVIDENCE (train, n=4000, local ablation): full AUC 0.930; all hidden children mean-ablated 0.674; all children replaced by their joint least-squares linear fit 0.832 (L2 logistic regression train 0.843). Nonlinear gain ~0.098 AUC comes from two children: dayEveUsageHinges (linearise drop 0.046, restore-alone gain 0.078) and serviceCallsHinges (0.020, 0.052); together they restore the full 0.930. The other four children are affine on the input domain (linearise drop 0.000). Rare-category effects (state:11 -2.33 via 6233, state:46 -2.00 direct, state:47 +1.39 direct) are constant offsets that roughly equal the calibrating offsets on train, larger than the raw log-odds offsets.

reference_patient.definition: the typical patient: the median training patient for every number and the most common training category for every category (not a real patient)

confidence_rules.clearly: a meaningful change in predicted risk for a typical patient (at least 5% points), the test split agrees (same sign, and its bootstrap interval over test patients excludes no benefit), and every group has at least 20 training patients
confidence_rules.consistently across patients: the claim holds for at least 90% of training patients (range across patients); this is not a significance statement
confidence_rules.on the training data only: the test split disagrees (opposite sign, or no benefit on test patients) or is unclear (its interval includes no benefit), or no test check is available
confidence_rules.slightly: the change in predicted risk for a typical patient is below 5% points
confidence_rules.the model has little data on this: a compared group has fewer than 20 training patients
